extension.description: Enforces the C++ Core Guidelines modernised for C++20: violations are errors, optional recommendations are warnings, and every diagnostic offers quick fixes.
command.openRule: Open the documentation of a rule
command.suppress: Suppress a rule on a line (justification required)
config.enableOptionalWarnings: Report the *optional/recommended* guidelines (`Prefer`, `Consider`, `Avoid`, rules explicitly marked as recommendations and the `CPP20.*` modernisations) as warnings. Turn this off to silence **all** warnings; errors are never affected.
config.run.onSave: Only when a file is opened or saved.
config.exclude: Glob patterns of files that are never analysed (third-party and generated code).
config.gsl.enabled: The Microsoft GSL is available. Rules that need an entity without a C++20 equivalent (`owner<T>`, `not_null`, `finally`, `narrow_cast`) are only checked, and their quick fixes only offered, when this is on.
config.modules.enforce: Also require `import` instead of `#include` for standard headers (rule `CPP20.modules`). Off by default because it depends on toolchain support.
config.fileSuffixes.sources: File suffixes accepted for implementation files (NL.27 / SF.1).
config.fileSuffixes.headers: File suffixes accepted for header files (NL.27 / SF.1).
config.thresholds.maxFunctionLines: F.3: maximum number of lines of a function (the guideline suggests 60).
config.thresholds.maxFunctionColumns: F.3: maximum line length inside a function (the guideline suggests 140).
config.thresholds.maxCyclomaticComplexit: F.3: maximum number of logical paths through a function (the guideline suggests 10).
config.thresholds.digitSeparatorMinDigit: NL.11: digit sequences with at least this many digits need digit separators (the guideline suggests 7).
config.thresholds.maxParameters: I.23: maximum number of function parameters.
config.magicConstants.allowList: ES.45: literals that are not considered magic constants.
config.clangTidy.enabled: Also run `clang-tidy` and map its `cppcoreguidelines-*`/`modernize-*` diagnostics (needs `clang-tidy` and a `compile_commands.json`).
